title: Willamette Valley Wine Tasting Tour
includes: Pick-up & Drop-off At Downtown Portland Hotels
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: The best wineries in Oregon lie just under an hour’s drive from Portland in the Willamette Valley, a thriving wine region known for its outstanding Pinot Noir.
